lines.text: At one o'clock, the hands make thirty degrees. A nice whole number.
lines.caption: At one o'clock, the hands make thirty degrees. A nice whole number.

lines.text: One minute later? Twenty-four and a half! Not whole.
lines.caption: One minute later? Twenty-four and a half! Not whole.

lines.text: Look at every minute from one o'clock to one fifty-nine.
lines.caption: Look at every minute from one o'clock to one fifty-nine.

lines.text: At how many of those times is the smaller angle a whole number of degrees?
lines.caption: At how many of those times is the smaller angle a whole number of degrees?

lines.text: The minute hand moves six degrees a minute. Always whole.
lines.caption: The minute hand moves six degrees a minute. Always whole.

lines.text: The hour hand moves half a degree a minute.
lines.caption: The hour hand moves half a degree a minute.

lines.text: Even minutes: whole. Odd minutes: a half.
lines.caption: Even minutes: whole. Odd minutes: a half.

lines.text: Whole minus a half is never whole. So every other minute works!
lines.caption: Whole minus a half is never whole. So every other minute works!

lines.text: Half of the sixty times. That's thirty!
lines.caption: Half of the sixty times. That's thirty!

lines.text: The full lesson shows two neat ways, plus every trap.
lines.caption: The full lesson shows two neat ways, plus every trap.
